title: Palo Alto NGFW or Fortinet FortiGate: Which Firewall Fits Your Organisation?
excerpt: Two of the most widely deployed next-generation firewalls, compared on what changes day-to-day operations: depth of application control, how hard each is to run with a small team, total cost and throughput with TLS inspection switched on.
verdict: Choose Palo Alto when application-level control and advanced threat analysis are the priority and the budget can carry higher licensing and support costs, which is typical of larger enterprises. Choose FortiGate when price-to-performance and simpler day-to-day management matter more, which suits most mid-sized organisations. Either way, size the appliance for the throughput you will see with full TLS inspection enabled, not the headline firewall figure.
